# reco_posture_check (Resource)

Manages a Reco posture check policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reco_posture_check" "admins_without_mfa" {
  title                  = "Admin accounts without MFA"
  description            = "Flags administrator accounts that have not enrolled in multi-factor authentication."
  data_source            = "GSUITE_USERS_API"
  violation_risk_level   = "HIGH"
  violation_risk_type    = "RISK_TYPE_USER"
  default_status         = "POLICY_STATUS_PREVIEW"
  posture_unique_jsonata = "$.primaryEmail"
  posture_value_jsonata  = "$.primaryEmail"
  conditions_jsonata     = "$.isAdmin = true and $.isEnrolledIn2Sv = false"
  how_to_remediate       = "Require the administrator to enroll in 2-Step Verification."
  why_should_i_care      = "Administrator accounts without MFA are a common entry point for account takeover."
  tags                   = ["identity", "mfa"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression that evaluates to true when an entity violates the check. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `data_source` (String) Data source the check evaluates, e.g. GSUITE_USERS_API. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `posture_unique_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression that uniquely identifies each tracked entity (min 2 chars), e.g. $.primaryEmail. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `posture_value_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression returning the display value for each tracked entity (min 2 chars), e.g. $.primaryEmail. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title (min 10 chars).
- `violation_risk_level` (String) Severity of a failing posture issue: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `violation_risk_type` (String) Risk category: RISK_TYPE_UNKNOWN, RISK_TYPE_DATA, RISK_TYPE_USER, RISK_TYPE_USER_TARGET, RISK_TYPE_USER_GROUP, or RISK_TYPE_APPLICATION. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.

### Optional

- `default_status` (String) Initial status for new instances: POLICY_STATUS_OFF, POLICY_STATUS_PREVIEW, or POLICY_STATUS_ON. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `description` (String) Longer description shown in the Reco UI.
- `how_to_remediate` (String) Remediation guidance shown to operators. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `status_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression evaluated over the results that returns true when the check fails. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.
- `tags` (List of String) Categorization tags.
- `why_should_i_care` (String) Business context explaining why this check matters. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import.

### Read-Only

- `app_source` (String) Source application identifier (read-only).
- `id` (String) Posture check ID (stable UUID, set after create).
- `severity` (String) Severity level returned by the API (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = reco_posture_check.admins_without_mfa
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```
